agreements: Gearbox v1 verified baseline and Step009 Heartbeat verified foundation remain preserved; this review changes no formal state/code and claims no C PASS.

v2 strict-validates inherited routing booleans and v2.1 strict-validates secretary_signal_fresh, authority_conflict and direct verification booleans; this is useful type hardening but is not provenance/authority proof.
v2 real_experience_claim_allowed requires verified-kind credit plus C_VERIFIED stage; this gate must not be bypassed by the v2.1 projection layer.
v2.1 classifies DURABLE_PROGRESS and ADVERSARIAL_DEFECT_FOUND as operational-only, while HEARTBEAT/POLL/RETRY/WAIT/SCHEDULER_WAKE remain zero Experience.
verified_progress_density is reason-only in current bytes and cannot itself raise gear or create Experience; keep it observational.
The v2.1 contract correctly marks speedup NOT_YET_STATISTICALLY_ESTABLISHED.

disagreements.finding: New material gap: v2 refuses real_experience_claim_allowed unless verification_stage is C_VERIFIED, but v2.1 recomputes verified_experience_delta directly from event_kind + event_independently_verified and does not apply the inherited verification-stage gate. The same VERIFIED_RECOVERY with event_independently_verified=true can therefore produce v2 real_experience_claim_allowed=false at CANDIDATE/UNVERIFIED stage while v2.1 still reports verified_experience_delta=4. This creates contradictory cross-layer Experience semantics and a direct promotion/accounting bypass if downstream treats the v2.1 field as authoritative.
disagreements.required_change: v2.1 must not independently mint authoritative verified Experience. Project only an immutable AcceptedExperienceReceipt whose evidence identity, trusted C/independent-verifier receipt and canonical verification stage are mutually bound. Until then, non-C_VERIFIED or receipt-less calls must emit verified_experience_delta=0 authoritative credit; analytics-only values must be explicitly labelled non-authoritative.

disagreements.finding: select_gear_v2_1 parses recent_shift_rate_ratio and verified_progress_density before inherited v2 resolves rollback_required/standby, so malformed nonessential telemetry can block canonical R/N terminal safety decisions.
disagreements.required_change: Resolve trusted rollback/standby terminal authority before nonessential telemetry parsing, or use a trusted prevalidated telemetry envelope whose parse failure cannot block the safer terminal result.

disagreements.finding: EventKind normalization remains inconsistent across experience_candidate_delta, select_gear_v2 verified-event classification and v2.1 direct classification.
disagreements.required_change: Use one versioned canonical typed EventKind parser exactly once across v2/v2.1 credit, ledger and classification paths.

disagreements.finding: secretary_signal_fresh and authority_conflict remain caller declarations. Strict bool proves type only, not source, timestamp/TTL, revocation, scope, policy or runtime/installation binding.
disagreements.required_change: Require trusted SecretarySignalEnvelope and AuthorityDecisionEnvelope with replay-resistant provenance/freshness binding.

disagreements.finding: authority_conflict only neutralizes secretary_level; it does not load or enforce the exact fresh authority decision, so permissive fallback kwargs still control routing.
disagreements.required_change: Project the exact trusted fresh authority snapshot or fail closed.

disagreements.finding: Secretary freshness protects secretary_level only; numeric pressure fields have no per-field provenance/freshness and can carry stale secretary-derived telemetry into routing.
disagreements.required_change: Bind provenance/freshness per pressure component; stale secretary-derived components contribute zero while independently trusted telemetry may contribute.

disagreements.finding: recent_shift_rate_ratio is caller supplied and thresholded at >=0.50 without canonical numerator/denominator, minimum sample, observation window, uncertainty or stateful enter/exit hysteresis.
disagreements.required_change: Derive from canonical append-only shift history with preregistered support/window/uncertainty and bounded hysteretic release.

disagreements.finding: Anti-thrash can reduce gear_shift_rate while delaying a safe necessary upshift and worsening cycle_completion_latency, verified_closure_per_hour or recovery_latency.
disagreements.required_change: Require paired performance non-regression; fewer shifts alone is not improvement.

disagreements.finding: Verified Experience still depends on event kind, booleans and stage labels; exact evidence hash plus trusted C/independent-verifier identity/receipt are not mandatory.
disagreements.required_change: Require immutable evidence identity and trusted verifier acceptance receipt bound to mission/step/scope, freshness/revocation and installation/workspace identity.

disagreements.finding: event_id dedupe exists only inside one aggregate call. Same evidence under new IDs, cross-run/restart/rollback/poll replay and same-ID rebinding can still be re-credited.
disagreements.required_change: Use a durable rollback-resistant event/evidence-lineage acceptance registry with exact replay NO_OP and rebinding IDENTITY_CONFLICT.

disagreements.finding: aggregate_experience_events canonicalizes event_id with str(...).strip(), allowing arbitrary caller types, numeric/string aliasing and unstable structured identities.
disagreements.required_change: Define a versioned strict EventIdentity boundary and bind accepted identity to canonical event/evidence/verifier receipt and durable acceptance record.

disagreements.finding: select_gear_v2_1 recomputes verified and operational deltas directly from caller event fields, bypassing aggregate_experience_events and any future durable-ledger repair.
disagreements.required_change: Every nonzero credit must come from one immutable AcceptedExperienceReceipt; receipt-less decision calls emit zero credit.

disagreements.finding: Public v2 still exposes DURABLE_PROGRESS and ADVERSARIAL_DEFECT_FOUND through experience_candidate_delta although v2.1 classifies them operational-only.
disagreements.required_change: Unify authoritative classification across v2/v2.1; operational progress must never appear in an authoritative Experience-labelled field.

disagreements.finding: 5/4/3 verified credits and operational 1 are engineering heuristics, not calibrated capability units.
disagreements.required_change: Never use aggregate credit as capability truth, Trust, Identity, Personality or promotion threshold.

disagreements.finding: No exact-current paired evaluation establishes speedup; commit count, wake count and awake time are invalid proxies.
disagreements.required_change: Use sealed matched workloads and paired/crossover baselines over durable_progress_per_wake, verified_closure_per_hour, cycle_completion_latency, rework_ratio and recovery_latency with frozen metric provenance, exposure/censoring/order, complete assigned-workload coverage, uncertainty and verification/risk non-regression.

statistical_risks: Cross-layer stage inconsistency can count the same event as non-authoritative in v2 but verified in v2.1, contaminating longitudinal Experience totals and any model-selection analysis based on them.
Caller-declared secretary freshness/authority and unbound pressure provenance invalidate causal routing comparisons.
Small-n caller-supplied shift-rate estimates can false-trigger anti-thrash or chatter around the threshold.
Anti-thrash may improve gear_shift_rate while degrading cycle/closure/recovery latency.
verified_progress_density becomes self-reinforcing if later connected to routing authority; it must remain observational until independently derived and tested.
Transient event IDs, same-evidence/new-ID replay, noncanonical identity and direct credit bypass can inflate or censor longitudinal Experience/progress totals.
Operational-vs-Experience semantics differ between v2 and v2.1, making mixed-consumer metrics incomparable.
5/4/3/1 credits are ordinal engineering heuristics, not capability units.
Speed metrics are numerator/denominator/exposure/order/coverage sensitive and require matched paired/crossover evaluation.

GB21-V21-STAGE-CONSISTENCY-106: across UNVERIFIED/CANDIDATE/BUILT_NOT_VERIFIED/C_VERIFIED, v2 and v2.1 must project one canonical verification-stage/evidence eligibility result with no cross-layer contradiction.
GB21-TERMINAL-TELEMETRY-PARSE-103 + STANDBY-TELEMETRY-PARSE-104: malformed nonessential telemetry cannot block trusted R/N terminal decisions.
GB21-EVENT-KIND-WHITESPACE-101 + EVENT-KIND-CROSSPATH-102: all v2/v2.1 paths consume one canonical EventKind value.

must_have: Fresh exact-current same-runner PASS for v1+v2+v2.1 candidate bytes; historical PASS cannot substitute.
Single canonical typed/versioned EventKind and EventIdentity boundaries shared by v2/v2.1.
Trusted SecretarySignalEnvelope and exact AuthorityDecisionEnvelope; stale/conflicting secretary data has zero routing effect and fresh authority decision is actually projected.
Pressure components carry source/freshness/incident-lineage binding; stale secretary-derived pressure cannot route through numeric side channels.
Anti-thrash metric is derived from canonical append-only shift history with preregistered sample/window/uncertainty and bounded enter/exit hysteresis; paired performance non-regression required.

Every verified Experience unit is bound to immutable exact evidence identity plus trusted C/independent-verifier acceptance receipt and compatible canonical verification stage; v2/v2.1 cannot disagree on eligibility.

Durable rollback-resistant event/evidence-lineage registry provides exact replay NO_OP, same-evidence/new-ID duplicate handling, same-ID/different-binding IDENTITY_CONFLICT and cross-run/restart/rollback/poll resistance.
All verified and operational credit flows through immutable AcceptedExperienceReceipt; direct caller-field credit paths are zero/non-authoritative.

DURABLE_PROGRESS and ADVERSARIAL_DEFECT_FOUND remain operational-only on every authoritative public interface; heartbeat/poll/retry/reconnect/wait/scheduler wake/window age/uptime remain zero Experience.
5/4/3/1 weights remain explicitly heuristic and cannot gate capability, Trust, Identity, Personality, Governance or promotion.

Speedup requires sealed matched paired/crossover baseline using durable_progress_per_wake, verified_closure_per_hour, cycle_completion_latency, rework_ratio and recovery_latency with frozen metric provenance/exposure/censoring/order, full assigned-workload coverage, uncertainty and verification/risk non-regression.
Dedicated fresh W03 adversarial review and fresh W04 synthesis over current exact bytes with zero unresolved release vetoes before any A->B->C adoption route.
